_draft: DRAFT library for lore step 1: placeholder text written to exercise the generator. The owner rewrites every text field.

events.text: {date}: the first native life took hold on {site}.
{date}: a strange biosphere bloomed across {site}, unlike anything native to the region.
{date}: the {civ} rose on {site}, first among its living things, led by {founder}.
{date}: a new people, the {civ}, built over the ruins of the {former} on {site}, led by {founder}.
{date}{during_war}: {civ} settlers under {founder} moved into the empty halls the {former} left on {site}.
{date}: great shaggy people, the {civ}, built stone halls in the high country of {site} under {elder}.
{date}{during_war}: colonists of the {civ} settled {site} under {founder}.
{date}: the {civ} raised an outpost on {site}.
{date}: {civ} prospectors staked a mining claim on {site}; {foreman} ran the dig.
{date}: the {civ} built a station here and crewed it under {commander}.
{date}: {civ} drones assembled an uncrewed relay here. No one ever came aboard.
{date}: the {civ} settled the volcanic islands of {site}.
{date}: the {civ} colony on {site} grew into a nation.
{date}: the {civ} of {site} left the {tech} behind.
{date}: a golden age of the {civ} on {site}, under {ruler}.
{date}: {chief_engineer} of the {civ} lit a great reactor on {site}.
{date}: the {civ} opened a sealed laboratory on {site}; {researcher} led it.
{date}{during_war}: refugees of the {civ} landed on {site} with nothing, led by {elder}.
{date}: the {civ} raised an observatory on {site}; {astronomer} charted the region from it.
{date}: {archivist} of the {civ} sealed the records of {site} in a vault below the surface.
{date}: the {civ} sealed their settlement on {site} under pressure domes.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} survey ship mapped {site} and moved on.
{date}: the {civ} planted a claim beacon on {site}. Nobody came to work the claim.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} ship came down hard on {site}. No one walked away from it.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} lander crashed on {site}; {pilot} and the crew are buried beside it.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} expedition under {expedition_leader} set out across {site} and never came back.
{date}: {civ} and {enemy} pickets clashed over {site}; the hulks were left where they fell.
{date}{during_war}: the {civ} and the {enemy} fought over {site}; the wreckage still circles it.
{date}: an asteroid struck {site} and left a field of craters.
{date}: an impact flattened the {civ} settlements on {site}.
{date}{during_war}: the {civ} gave up on {site}; {governor} ordered the last ships out.
{date}{during_war}: the {civ} withdrew from {site}, one ship at a time, until no one was left.
{date}: the {civ} colony on {site} starved through a hard decade. {governor} kept the last log.
{date}: the {civ} of {site} fell apart under {last_ruler}; their cities emptied.
{date}: the {civ} of {site} dwindled to scattered bands in the wilds.
{date}: the {civ} station went silent. {commander}'s last message was a distress call.
{date}: the relay's makers stopped answering it. It kept running alone.
{date}: eruptions drove the {civ} off the islands of {site}.
{date}: the seas of {site} rose over the {civ} cities. Some got off-world; most did not.
{date}: the sun of {site} flared and burned it clean.
{date}{during_war}: the {civ} of {site} turned their {weapon} on each other. The fallout killed everything.
{date}: the {civ} reactor on {site} failed under {chief_engineer}. Nothing survived the fallout.
{date}: a nanite swarm took {site} apart and rebuilt it in wire. The {civ} went with it.
{date}: a hive spread across {site} and ate everything that lived there.
{date}: the ice came down over {site}. The {civ} fled south, then off-world.
{date}: {sage} was born among the {civ} of {site}; the {civ} still quote {sage}.
{date}: {elder} of the {civ} died, and all of {site} mourned.
{date}: the {civ} of {site} first kept the {feast}.
{date}: a famine year on {site}; the {civ} ate their seed grain.
{date}: part of the {civ} of {site} migrated to the far side of the world.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} trading ship called at {site} and stayed a season.
{date}{during_war}: {civ} raiders struck the settlements of {site} and were gone by morning.
{date}: the {civ} raised a monument on {site} to {leader}.
{date}: a great quake shook {site}.
{date}: a comet passed close over {site}; its tail lit the sky for a season.
{date}: great herds crossed {site}, and the land changed behind them.
{date}: a meteor fell on {site} and left a glassy scar.
{date}{during_war}: a {civ} ship crossed the sky over {site} without stopping.
{date}{during_war}: {civ} spacers buried a cache on {site} and never came back for it.
{date}: two peoples rose on {site} at once, the {civ} on one side of the world and the {enemy} on the other; {founder} led the {civ}.
events.text_side: {date}: we, the {civ}, rose under {founder}. Across the water lived the {enemy}, and they were not like us.
events.text_meanwhile: {date}: on the far side of {site}, {founder} led the {civ}.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} of {site} left the {tech} behind, and the {enemy} took note.
events.text_meanwhile: {date}: the {civ} kept pace, leaving the {tech} behind.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} and the {enemy} drew a border across {site}.
{date}: an uneasy peace held between the {civ} and the {enemy} for a generation.
{date}: war broke out on {site} between the {civ} and the {enemy}; {warlord} led the {civ}.
events.text_side: {date}: the {enemy} struck first. {warlord} called us, the {civ}, to arms.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} fortified their side of {site} against the {enemy}.
events.text_side: {date}: we, the {civ}, built our walls against the {enemy}. Let them come.
events.text_meanwhile: {date}: across the border the {civ} fortified their own side.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} and the {enemy} met in battle on {site} with {weapon}; the dead lie where they fell, and {warlord} lived to fight again.
{date}: the {civ} and the {enemy} met in battle on {site} with {weapon}; {warlord} of the {civ} fell with half the army.
{date}: a truce between the {civ} and the {enemy} ended when {envoy} was murdered at the border.
{date}: the war on {site} ended with nobody left to win it; the {civ} starved in their ruined halls, as did the {enemy}.
events.text_side: {date}: we, the last of the {civ}, have outlived the {enemy}, but not by long.
events.text_meanwhile: {date}: the {civ} did not outlast them by a season.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} and the {enemy} turned their {weapon} on each other. Nothing on {site} survived.
events.text_side: {date}: the {enemy} launched. So did we, the {civ}, and the sky burned.
events.text_meanwhile: {date}: the {civ} answered with {weapon} within the hour.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} won their war against the {enemy} and lost everything else; they live as wanderers among the ruins of both.
{date}: a {civ} ship landed among the {enemy} of {site}; {envoy} came bearing gifts.
{date}: taught by the {enemy}, the {civ} of {site} left the {tech} behind in a single generation.
{date}: the {civ} left {site} as suddenly as they came; the {enemy} carried on alone.
{date}: the {civ} left {site}, and the {enemy} quarrelled over the weapons they left behind.
{date}: the {civ} broke away from the {enemy} of {site}, taking the visitors' weapons with them.
{date}: the {civ} came down on {site} and put the {enemy} to work in their mines; {overseer} held the whip.
{date}: another generation of the {civ} died in the mines of the {enemy}.
{date}: the {enemy} rose against the {civ} on {site}; {overseer} died, and the {civ} fled and left a warship behind.
{date}: the {civ} rose against the {enemy} and were crushed; the {enemy} left {site} with all they had dug.
{date}: war broke out between the {civ} and the {enemy}{war_end}.

how: a survey team cut it open

events.text: {date}: the old wreck on {site} was disturbed: {how}.
{date}: a plague ran through what was left of the {civ} on {site}, and the dead got up again.
events.omen: The dead do not stay down here.

events.text: {date}: something got out of the sealed {civ} laboratory on {site}.
events.omen: Something got out of the old laboratory.

events.text: {date}: the crew of the crashed {civ} lander did not stay buried.
events.omen: The crash site is not quiet.

events.text: {date}: the dead crew of the old {civ} wreck on {site} began to rise.
events.omen: The old wreck's crew walks again.

events.text: {date}: a crystal blight broke out of the deep places of {site} and began twisting the wildlife.
events.omen: A crystal blight is spreading.

events.text: {date}: the dead {civ} reactor on {site} has been leaking for years; the wildlife around it changed.
events.omen: The wildlife near the old reactor has changed.

events.text: {date}: the drive of the old {civ} wreck on {site} cracked, and the creatures nearby mutated.
events.omen: A wrecked drive is leaking; the creatures around it have changed.

events.text: {date}: an experiment aboard the station went wrong; things moved in the dark decks.
events.omen: Something moves in the dark decks.

events.text: {date}{during_war}: a {civ} warship, hunted by the {enemy}, was shot down over {site}.
events.omen: A warship came down here recently.

events.text: {date}{during_war}: a {civ} ship fleeing the {enemy} limped down onto {site}.
events.omen: A damaged ship came down here recently.

events.text: {date}{during_war}: a {civ} scout misjudged its landing on {site}.
events.omen: A scout ship crashed here recently.

events.text: {date}: a {civ} salvage crew came for what was left aboard.
events.omen: Someone else is already aboard.

events.text: {date}: a meteor fell on {site} carrying xeno spores.
events.omen: A recent impact carried xeno spores.

events.text: {date}: the last {civ} to leave {site} left something in the hold behind them.
events.omen: Something was left behind in a hold.

events.text: {date}{during_war}: the {civ} seeded {site} with xenos to deny it to the {enemy}.
events.omen: Xenos were seeded here on purpose.

events.text: {date}: the eggs in the hold of the old {civ} wreck on {site} hatched.
events.omen: Eggs in an old wreck have hatched.

events.text: {date}: troids crawled out of the old impact craters on {site}.
events.omen: Troids crawl from the craters.

events.text: {date}: an Autonz swarm made planetfall on {site}.
events.omen: An Autonz swarm has landed.

events.text: {date}: the dormant swarm aboard the old {civ} wreck on {site} woke up.
events.omen: A dormant swarm in an old wreck has woken.

events.text: {date}: something huge started moving under the ground of {site}.
events.omen: Something huge moves underground.

events.text: {date}: the descendants of the {civ} came back down from the high country of {site}.
events.omen: The old natives have come back down.

events.text: {date}: the old {civ} reactor on {site} cracked open again. It has been leaking ever since.
events.omen: An old reactor is leaking.

events.text: {date}: rain washed the old fallout on {site} into a few hot pools that never cooled.
events.omen: Pockets of old fallout are still hot.

events.text: {date}: the drive core of the {civ} wreck on {site} split and began to bleed radiation.
events.omen: A wrecked drive core is leaking.

events.text: {date}: a patch of glowing crystal broke through the ground of {site} and stopped growing.
events.omen: A patch of glowing crystal has taken root.

events.text: {date}: seismic tremors on {site} traced a burrow; something has nested in the rock.
events.omen: Tremors trace a burrow in the rock.

events.text: {date}: something laid its eggs in the shelter of the {civ} wreck on {site}. They have not hatched yet.
events.omen: Something has nested here. The eggs have not hatched.

events.text: {date}: troids laid a clutch in the old impact crater on {site}.
events.omen: A troid clutch sits in an old crater.

events.text: {date}: a pair of yetis came down from the high country of {site} and made it their hunting ground.
events.omen: A pair of yetis hunts nearby.

events.text: {date}: a band of mutants made a lair on {site}.
events.omen: A mutant band lairs in the ruins.

events.text: {date}: the {civ} dead on {site} did not stay buried.
events.omen: The old graves are restless.

events.text: {date}: an Autonz enforcer crawled into the old {civ} hull on {site} and powered down, waiting.
events.omen: Something mechanical waits, powered down.

events.text: {date}: the last of the {civ} still haunt the ruins of {site}; they take strangers for enemies.
events.omen: Survivors of an old war still hold the ruins.

events.text: {date}: the last of the {civ}, changed by their world, still haunt the ruins of {site}.
events.omen: Survivors of an old war still hold the ruins.

events.text: {date}: spore pods swelled up out of the ground of {site}; anything that brushes them sickens.
events.omen: Spore pods have taken root here.

events.text: {date}: a cave under {site} came down; something was buried in the fall.
events.omen: The ground here has fallen in.

events.text: {date}: the old defences of {site} were never stood down; they are waiting still.
events.omen: Old defences still guard this place.

events.text: {date}: the shells that did not go off in the battle on {site} are still in the ground.
events.omen: Unexploded shells litter an old battlefield.

events.text: {date}: a section of the station on {site} blew out; its stores are still in there, in the vacuum.
events.omen: A section of the station is open to space.

events.text: {date}: the colonists landed on {site} and founded the {colony} colony.
{date}: the last colonists beamed up from {site}. The {colony} colony stands empty.
{date}: the {colony} colony on {site} was lost with every colonist on it.
{date}: {colonist} died on {site}{cause}.
{date}: {boss} was killed on {site}{cause}.
{date}: the colonists completed {quest} on {site}.
{date}: the colonists took the contract {quest}.
{date}: the last {threat} on {site} was destroyed.
